title: Tall vessel from Tenerife
supplementalReferenceLabel: La Piedra Zanata · Vessel from Los Frontones, fig. 26
documentedDimensions: The amphora-shaped vessel 34.1/M from Montaña Blanca is 400 mm high and 240 mm in diameter at its widest point. The model uses those dimensions at 1:2 scale.
modelDimensions: 200 mm high · Ø 120 mm at the widest point · 128 mm including the lugs
description: A teaching model based on the Tenerife badge in the MitoMapa passport. It keeps the oval body, the narrow grooved neck, the row of dots and the two pierced lugs.
adaptations: The flat base and pointed tops of the holes in the lugs allow the model to print upright without supports. The opening, lugs and decoration follow the badge.
